title_zh: 瓜达尔港：中巴经济走廊的深水港
title_en: China's Ports (11/20): Gwadar, the Deepwater Port of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
note_en: 若 is a formal, written equivalent of 如果 "if": 瓜达尔港若能充分运营，将有助于缩短... "if Gwadar were fully operational, it would help cut..." Note that 若 comes after the subject, not at the very start like English "if," and the result clause is introduced by 将 (will), the bookish counterpart of 会.
